About Filmcode

Every movie has a color story. Filmcode is a free movie guessing game that invites you to recognize films through their visual palettes rather than dialogue, actors or plot summaries.

What is a movie color barcode?

Filmcode reduces selected movie frames to colored stripes and keeps their chronological order. Together, those stripes form an abstract visual journey from the opening to the finale. The result captures a film's palette, not an exact timestamp for every stripe.

One movie, four choices

Study the complete barcode, choose the film you think it represents, and discover the answer. Filmcode is currently running a pilot challenge. Learn how to play.
